name: Aargonar
description: Aargonar was a planet located in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, the husband of Confederacy of Independent Systems Senator Mina Bonteri went there to set up a base for the Separatists, but was killed when Republic clone troopers attacked. The planet was also the homeworld of the human Imperial stormtrooper TK-14057.
